menswear.title: Tonal dressing
menswear.tip: Wear two or three shades of one palette colour — for example a light shirt, mid knit and dark trousers in the same family.

menswear.title: One accent near the face
menswear.tip: Keep trousers and shoes neutral and let your strongest palette shade sit in a tee, tie or pocket square.

menswear.title: Festive contrast
menswear.tip: Pair a rich kurta from your palette with a lighter churidar and a dark Nehru jacket for depth without clashing.

womenswear.title: Monochrome with texture
womenswear.tip: Head-to-toe in one palette shade looks polished when fabrics vary — knit, satin and denim together.

womenswear.title: Palette near the face
womenswear.tip: Your most flattering shade works hardest as a top, scarf or dupatta; keep colours to avoid for skirts and shoes.

womenswear.title: Festive pairing
womenswear.tip: Choose a saree or lehenga in a deep palette shade and echo a lighter shade in the blouse or dupatta.

unisex.title: Neutral base, one accent
unisex.tip: Build on palette neutrals and add one brighter shade through a tee, beanie or bag.

unisex.title: Analogous layering
unisex.tip: Layer colours that sit next to each other on the colour wheel for an easy, cohesive outfit.

unisex.title: Contrast at the top
unisex.tip: A lighter top with darker bottoms keeps attention near your face.

mixed.title: Tonal dressing
mixed.tip: Wear several shades of one palette colour with different textures.

mixed.title: Palette near the face
mixed.tip: Put your best shade closest to your face and use colours to avoid lower down.

mixed.title: One accent
mixed.tip: Let one bright palette shade carry the outfit and keep the rest neutral.

mixed.title: Consistency over novelty
mixed.tip: A gentle cleanser, moisturiser and daily sunscreen used every day usually matter more than any single new launch.

mixed.title: One change at a time
mixed.tip: Introduce new products one at a time, a couple of weeks apart, so you can tell what suits you.

mixed.title: Sunscreen as the last morning step
mixed.tip: Apply a generous amount every morning and reapply when you're outdoors for long periods.

menswear.title: Shape the sides first
menswear.tip: Ask your barber how short the sides should be relative to the top — it changes the overall face proportion more than length on top.

menswear.title: Frames that match your features
menswear.tip: Choose frames roughly as wide as your face, with the top edge following your brow line.

menswear.title: Keep a clean neckline
menswear.tip: Whatever the cut, a tidy neckline and sideburns make it look fresh for longer.

womenswear.title: Face-framing layers
womenswear.tip: Layers that start at the cheekbones or chin let you change shape without losing length.

womenswear.title: Frames that match your features
womenswear.tip: Choose frames roughly as wide as your face, with the top edge following your brow line.

womenswear.title: Parting play
womenswear.tip: Switching from a centre to a side parting changes balance instantly — no cut needed.

unisex.title: Work with your texture
unisex.tip: Cuts designed for your natural texture need far less daily styling.

unisex.title: Frames that match your features
unisex.tip: Choose frames roughly as wide as your face, with the top edge following your brow line.

unisex.title: Regular light trims
unisex.tip: Small, regular trims keep any length looking intentional.

mixed.title: Work with your texture
mixed.tip: Cuts designed for your natural texture need far less daily styling.

mixed.title: Frames that match your features
mixed.tip: Choose frames roughly as wide as your face, with the top edge following your brow line.

mixed.title: Parting play
mixed.tip: Switching your parting changes balance instantly — no cut needed.

menswear.title: Tailoring is the upgrade
menswear.tip: Hemming trousers and taking in a shirt's sides make inexpensive pieces look made for you.

menswear.title: Three-piece rule
menswear.tip: Add a third layer — overshirt, knit or jacket — to turn a tee and trousers into an outfit.

menswear.title: Shoes set the tone
menswear.tip: The same jeans and shirt read casual with sneakers and smart with loafers.

womenswear.title: One fitted, one relaxed
womenswear.tip: Pair a fitted piece with a relaxed one so outfits feel balanced and comfortable.

womenswear.title: Third-piece layering
womenswear.tip: A blazer, cardigan or dupatta turns two pieces into a finished look.

womenswear.title: Hem to your shoes
womenswear.tip: Hem trousers for the shoes you'll wear most so the line looks intentional.

unisex.title: Balance volume
unisex.tip: Pair one roomy piece with one neater piece so the outfit keeps shape.

unisex.title: Layer from thin to thick
unisex.tip: Tee, then shirt or knit, then jacket — easy to adjust through the day.

unisex.title: Consistent palette
unisex.tip: Two or three palette shades across your wardrobe make everything mix and match.

mixed.title: Balance volume
mixed.tip: Pair one roomy piece with one neater piece so the outfit keeps shape.

mixed.title: Third-piece layering
mixed.tip: A jacket, knit or overshirt turns two pieces into an outfit.

mixed.title: Tailoring is the upgrade
mixed.tip: Small alterations make everyday pieces look made for you.
